reviews.title: Nice Canopy, Works Great, Best Owned so far!
reviews.body: Good quality, easy to transport, sturdy and durable if guyed down as instructed.  Larger than normal footprint for shade or rain. reviews.author: James F Fagan

reviews.title: Really great value and quality!
reviews.body: This may be my best purchase ever.  I am so amazed at how this canopy has performed.  Purchased in Oct. of 2022 and have used since - year round in Seattle.  We get some serious wind in my area and when it comes, all we do is pop the red buttons on each leg and lower this thing down to avoid trouble.  In fact - that is how we store all our patio cushions - we put everything under and lower it for the whole season.  When the sun comes out - up it goes - so easy!  For wind resistance we bolted the legs to the deck and even though we left it up twice and the top blew off and frame inverted, no permanent damage to frame or material!  Two years in and we are just starting to see some slits in fabric, so I will buy replacement fabric this year.  After trying two retractable awnings (total fail) and several patio umbrellas (limited use) this is by far the best value and best performance.  Happy, happy, happy!

reviews.title: First one the top ripped after 3 months, and sent a free replacement!
reviews.body: Baught this to provide shade in our back yard. At up was fairly simple (easy 2 person job), not as simple as a standard pop-up tent. During the initial install, 2 of the ground stakes broke. Luckily a have bunch from other items I already own. After about a month the included tie down line completely disintegrated (turned into little puffs of white material blown all over our backyard). Not a problem, replaced them with some nylon cord from HD. A little over 3 months I noticed that the canopy was starting to rip too. Now a couple of weeks later I've taken it down before the winds start and notice that the canopy is dropping in the middle (not at a seem) and the whole thing feels supper brittle like the whole thing is about to fall apart. Good thing I got the extended warranty and can at least get some of my money back. After posting this review, the Cooshade reached out and sent a completely new canopy tent! Wow, thanks!

reviews.title: Great shade!  But needs a tad bit of customizing
reviews.body: Great sunshade and size!!  But let’s be honest – it’s not a bomb shelter and never was intended to be. So when it’s super stormy and windy you should take it down…or you run the risk of it ripping and bending.It doesn’t come with any setup/takedown instructions, but luckily I’ve owned one before so I pretty much knew what to do.One thing I learned really quickly that warrants your attention:  The 4 ropes to stake down the canopy are super flimsy. The ropes broke within weeks. So I put my thinking cap on and came up with a great solution. I bought 8 stainless steel carabiner hooks (4 to put on each stake; 4 for to put on each corner of the canopy) and about 30’ of stainless steel 1/8” chain.  I cut the chain with a bolt cutter and connected it to the hooks on the stakes and canopy. That hardware will outlast the canopy and won’t weaken with the weather.  Anchoring my canopy that way is amazing! I added 2 pictures to show what it looks like.Highly recommend spending the extra money for the hardware to make sure you successfully and effectively anchor your canopy.  Reasonably priced and bought those on Amazon as well.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2022

reviews.title: Get One Now
reviews.body: I really love this one. Durability is #1. I have bought many pop up tents over the years, but this one is overall my best buy yet. It lives up to its promise. I have had mine up for weeks now, and in the last week a storm came through with heavy rains and strong winds, and I expected to see it all twisted and torn as I did with pop ups in the past. But this baby stood tall through it all, and its still up. Not a single twist or tear. I haven't taken it down yet. The holes on it to prevent puddling is amazing. IT WORKS!! Very smart move on their part. Seriously recommend. Will buy another. Thank you cooshade!
